paper_metadata.title: Nanostructured Nb reinforced NiTi shape memory alloy composite with high strength and narrow hysteresis

evidence.quote: An in-situ nanostructured Nb reinforced NiTi shape-memory alloy composite was fabricated by mechanical reduction of an as-cast Nb-NiTi eutectic alloy.

evidence.quote: the nanocrystalline NiTi matrix underwent a recoverable lattice elastic strain of 2.0% in the tensile strain cycle of 5%
Using Hooke's law, the load taken by nanostructured Nb upon tensile loading can be estimated to be up to 3.7 GPa (Young's modulus of the Nb nanowires with <110> orientation is about 93 GPa).

mechanisms.name: load transfer from NiTi matrix to nanostructured Nb

evidence.quote: the high strength of composite can be attributed to the effective load transfer from the NiTi matrix to the nanostructured Nb and the effective barrier for the shear transformation of NiTi matrix from the densely spaced nanostructured Nb.

mechanisms.name: barrier effect of nanostructured Nb on shear transformation of NiTi matrix

evidence.quote: the sizes (~30 nm) and interspacing (~45 nm) are small enough for the nanostructured Nb to become effective barriers for the shear transformation of NiTi matrix.

mechanisms.name: grain nano-size effect reducing transformation hysteresis

evidence.quote: the narrow hysteresis of composite can be attributed the grain nano-size effect and small transformation deformation of NiTi matrix, and the assistance of internal stress for stress-induced transformation of matrix.
it can be speculated that the internal stress between nanostructured Nb and NiTi matrix may be developed during their co-deformation due to their elastic strain mismatch.
